# Agent Builder

> AI agents anyone can use. Three free, read-only MCP servers: build a single-file AI agent from an idea and run it on the user's data, find one of about 1,700 ready-made agents, or get verified world numbers with a public SHA-256 fingerprint. No account, no API key, nothing stored.

## MCP servers (streamable HTTP, no auth)

- [Agent Builder](https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/mcp): get_agent_template, check_agent, use_agent_here, find_agents, get_agent_code, share_agent, how_to_run_agent
- [Agent Finder](https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/finder/mcp): find_agents, get_agent_code, use_agent_here, how_to_run_agent
- [World Check](https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/world/mcp): world_now, fingerprint_text
- [Domain Check](https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/domains/mcp): check_domain, register_domain

## Pay per call (x402 v2, USDC)

- GET https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/x402/world: fresh verified world snapshot, $0.001
- POST https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/x402/domains/register?domain=NAME: register an available domain; the 402 response quotes the price; charged only if registration succeeds (raise your x402 client's default $1 per-payment cap first)

## A2A

- [Agent card](https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/.well-known/agent-card.json): JSON-RPC message/send at https://rapp-agent-builder.azurewebsites.net/a2a. Skills: find_agents, world_now, agent_template.

## Docs

- [Website](https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-chatgpt/): what it does, in plain words
- [Source](https://github.com/kody-w/rapp-chatgpt): server code, listing packages, tests
- [Agent registry](https://kody-w.github.io/RAR/): the public agent registry
- [Privacy](https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-chatgpt/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://kody-w.github.io/rapp-chatgpt/terms.html)
